legend: Chief Scientist Randward Lirili want to explore a N×N$$$N \times N$$$ grid on Larila using rovers.

Due to the high cost, each rover is programmable, but only with a sequence of M$$$M$$$ instructions moving the rover North (N), East (E), South (S), or West (W). The rover repeats this sequence of instructions infinitely.

Some of the tiles on the grid are too precarious for the rover to travel through, if the rover needs to execute an instruction that will cause the rover to travel onto one of these tiles, the rover will skip this instruction and go to the next one. Moving outside of the grid is also considered precarious.
The rover is said to have returned to base if the rover reaches one of the ships that have landed in this grid. When the rover reaches the ship, it stops.

Given a sequence of instructions, determine whether a rover will return to base for every starting tile on the grid. If a rover starts on a tile that is precarious, it crashes and burns and automatically fails to return to base.
input: The first line contains two integers N$$$N$$$ and M$$$M$$$ (1≤N,M≤500$$$1 \le N, M \le 500$$$).
Each of the next N$$$N$$$ lines contains a string of N$$$N$$$ characters describing a row of the grid, from north to south. Each character is one of . (safe), # (precarious), or S (ship).
The last line contains a string of M$$$M$$$ characters describing the move sequence. Each character is one of N (north), S (south), E (east), or W (west).
output: Print N$$$N$$$ lines, each containing N$$$N$$$ characters. The character at row i$$$i$$$, column j$$$j$$$ should be 1 if a rover starting at that cell returns to base, and 0 otherwise.
note: (1,1)$$$(1,1)$$$ is a ship — returned to base immediately.
(1,2)$$$(1,2)$$$ and (1,3)$$$(1,3)$$$: already on row 1, so N moves do nothing. Then W moves slide them toward (1,1)$$$(1,1)$$$, the sink.
(2,2)$$$(2,2)$$$: N goes to (1,2)$$$(1,2)$$$, then N does nothing (already row 1), then WW slides to (1,1)$$$(1,1)$$$. Escapes.

(3,1)$$$(3,1)$$$: N would go to (2,1)$$$(2,1)$$$, which is precarious. So N does nothing, N does nothing, W does nothing (already column 1), W does nothing. After one cycle it is still at (3,1)$$$(3,1)$$$. Stuck forever — output 0.
(3,3)$$$(3,3)$$$: N would go to (2,3)$$$(2,3)$$$ — precarious, blocked. Stays at (3,3)$$$(3,3)$$$. Repeats forever — output 0.

legend.ai: 首席科学家 Randward Lirili 想要使用探测车探索 Larila 上的一个 N×N$$$N \times N$$$ 网格。
由于成本高昂，每辆探测车都可以编程，但只能使用一串包含 M$$$M$$$ 条指令的序列，使探测车向北(N)、东(E)、南(S)或西(W)移动。探测车会无限重复执行这串指令。
网格中的一些格子过于危险，探测车无法驶过。如果探测车需要执行一条会使其驶入这些格子之一的指令，它将跳过该指令并执行下一条。驶出网格也被视为进入危险区域。
如果探测车到达了降落在该网格中的某艘飞船，就称其返回了基地。探测车到达飞船时会停止。
给定一串指令，判断探测车是否会从网格中的每个起始格子出发都返回基地。如果探测车从危险格子出发，它会坠毁，因此必然无法返回基地。

input.ai: 接下来的 N$$$N$$$ 行中，每行包含一个由 N$$$N$$$ 个字符组成的字符串，按从北到南的顺序描述网格的一行。每个字符为 .(安全)、#(危险)或 S(船)中的一个。
最后一行包含一个由 M$$$M$$$ 个字符组成的字符串，描述移动序列。每个字符为 N(北)、S(南)、E(东)或 W(西)中的一个。

output.ai: 输出 N$$$N$$$ 行，每行包含 N$$$N$$$ 个字符。如果从该单元格出发的探测车能够返回基地，则第 i$$$i$$$ 行、第 j$$$j$$$ 列的字符应为 1，否则为 0。

note.ai: (3,1)$$$(3,1)$$$：N 本应移动到 (2,1)$$$(2,1)$$$，但那里处于危险状态。因此 N 什么也不做，N 什么也不做，W 什么也不做(已经在第 1 列)，W 什么也不做。经过一个循环后，它仍然位于 (3,1)$$$(3,1)$$$。永远被困住——输出 0。
